text_block_list.text:
"Cherry blossoms are late in blooming
nationwide"… 
All around the country,
people slumped their shoulders 
at this news.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Aww… I guess we can't have our flower viewing get-together… And I was looking forward to it so much… huuueh.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Don't let it get you down,
Chiyo! I'm sure you can 
find plenty of springtime fun in other
things.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
So I ask you,
what does springtime fun make you think
of? 
Exactly! Sakura horsegirls!!!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Indeedily!
The power of Sakura is bestowed through our
names!! With all three of us,
I say we have about 3 million Sakura
Power!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
If we travel through the country with that
power, we could 
very well be mistaken for the actual cherry
blossom front!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
A smile would surely bloom on people's faces
as they watch 
us — the Sakura front —
run past, almost like they were at 
an actual flower viewing!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
You're saying… the three of us should run
around Japan, 
brightening everyone's mood?
How wonderful!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Ah, why don't we post about what we're doing
on Umatter 
and Umatube?
That way even more people can see♪

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
What a great idea!
I can say quite a few people 
actually happen to follow me on Umatter!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
So horsegirls will become the heralds of
spring! 
That's lovely! Let's do it!
We'll be the Sakura front!!

Thus,
the curtain rises on three girls and
their 
"Bakushin-style Sakura Front Journey".
